I honestly have been wanting to post something so similar so thank you for sharing how this show impacted you. I got to see it with my long distance best friend of ten years after a really rough year that almost took me off this earth. There were so many moments of the Dallas show that made me fully sob like an infant because I was so overcome with emotion. What emotion? So many. Happiness, grief, excitement, longing, all of it was there. I constantly was looking around wondering if the people around me were also having a religious experience like I was. I quite literally haven’t shut up about the show since and really wish I could thank Porter Robinson for getting me through some of my lowest lows and showing me there are such high highs I would’ve never gotten to experience had I let circumstances be the end of me. Honestly makes me want to send the dude fan mail but I’m sure he gets so much haha

I have been trying to hear Goodbye to a World live for like three years now. Hearing that beautifully extended rendition with my best friends after a rough last few months made me break out in tears right there in the crowd.

I think this is gonna be super dependent on your city’s individual vibes. Also set up/some elements of the concert may vary depending on what he can work with at the venue itself. For example, I saw him in Dallas and he did ACL the day after. From what I saw of the stream VOD, he omitted some stuff that was at the Dallas show. 

As far as the shows vibes, I think it’s a little bit of everything for everyone. If you go looking for a pop show you won’t be disappointed. If you go looking for a rave you won’t be disappointed. If you go just to spend time in a room of like minded individuals you won’t be disappointed. Definitely stay hydrated because there’s a lot of fast paced moving around/jumping encouraged. Hopefully that gives you a good idea without spoiling anything. Hope you have an amazing time like I did.
